5929.content:
**`class file version 69.0 … up to 65.0`.** If the server dies at once and the console shows
`java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: … has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime (class file
version 69.0), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to 65.0` (on Fabric the line above
it is `An exception occurred when launching the server!`), the server was started with Java 21, and Minecraft 26.3 needs
**Java 25**: 69 is Java 25, 65 is Java 21 (a 1.21.1 server is fine on Java 21 — check that the server and the mod file
are for the same Minecraft version). The mod has nothing to do with it — a server without mods fails the same way.
Install Java 25 and point the server at it: on a host — in the panel (Java version or an image with Java 25), on your own
machine — with the full path to `java` in the start command (for NeoForge — in `run.sh` or `run.bat`). `java -version`
shows which Java is being started.

5930.content:
**A mod is missing.** Fabric: `Incompatible mods found!` and `requires version … or later of fabric-api, which is missing`
(or `… of geckolib …`); NeoForge: `requires geckolib 5.5.7 or above. Currently, geckolib is not installed` (on 1.20.1 — `4.8.4 or above`, on 1.21.1 —
`4.9.3 or above`: GeckoLib 4). The server’s
`mods` folder needs the same required mods as the players — see “Installation”.

Settings open with the gear in the journal’s header, from the game’s graphics settings or from the mod list (on Fabric

5941.content:
How richly the mod draws its effects on this computer. The choice applies at once, no restart needed. The first time you
open the journal, it asks you to choose and shows a live example of each level.

5942.content:

damage stays). No knob hides a danger sign: attack warnings, impact spots and field edges are drawn at any setting, and every
camera shake has its own sign besides it.

5962.content:
**Effects with shader packs** is a switch in the mod settings. With a shader pack (Iris, Oculus) the mod's post-effects turn
off by themselves; switch it on and they run with the pack too, at your own risk: the pack may spoil them (a black screen or
streaks: switch it off again). Tested with Complementary and Bliss.

5963.content:
The mod's screens (the journal, machine consoles, the storage terminal and others) are drawn in finer detail than the game's
own, and their small text is smaller than the game's letters. If they look too small at the GUI Scale that suits the game's
screens, the mod settings have a choice on the right of the Mod graphics line:

5964.content: **Match game** (the default) — the mod's screens follow GUI Scale, like the game's own;

5965.content: **Larger** — halfway to the largest, whatever GUI Scale is set to;

5966.content: **Largest** — always the largest that fits the game window, as with “GUI Scale: Auto”.

5967.content:
The mod's screens are always drawn in whole screen pixels (in-between sizes would look blurry), so the size is rounded to the
nearest step: on a 1920×1080 screen at GUI Scale 2 they are drawn pixel for pixel and Larger and Largest are twice as large,
at GUI Scale 3 and up the three are the same; at 1366×768 the three are the same.
The choice takes effect at once, even on an open screen; the game's screens and the mod's HUD do not change.

5968.content:
The whole screen grows, your inventory included: in machine consoles, the storage terminal and ship windows its slots,
items and stack counts on a 1920×1080 screen are as large as in the game's own inventory at GUI Scale 2 when Match game is set at
GUI Scale 2, and as at GUI Scale 4 otherwise.

5969.content:
A switch under Mod window size, **off** by default. Off, the storage terminal opens with its search box unfocused, so the
inventory key (E) closes it like any container; to search, click the box or press / or Tab (Ctrl+F works too). On, letters go
straight into the search as soon as the terminal opens, but E then types into the search instead of closing the window (Esc
clears the search first, then closes). The setting is yours alone: it is stored on your computer, not on the server.

5970.content:
Clicking anywhere outside the box (a stored item, a slot, a button) releases the search, so letters act as window keys again and
E closes the terminal. Back in the box (click, / or Tab), the query is selected and the first letter you type starts a new one, as in
the creative inventory search; the arrow keys clear the selection.

5971.content:
The mod plays the game's own recordings: each action has its own set, pitch and rhythm, and every ship has its own takeoff,
landing and maneuver sounds. The synthesized "Own sounds" are gone from the mod. Working machines hum (the four nearest within
sixteen blocks are heard), a ship's afterburner has a roar of its own, and a lair guardian waking or a gate crossing is marked
by a sound.

5972.content: The mod settings have two switches above the Done button, both on by default:

5973.content: **Aircraft sounds**: the ships' own takeoff, landing and maneuver sounds; off, a ship plays the older shared recordings;

5974.content: **Ambience sounds**: the sound backdrop of the worlds (below); off, it falls silent at once.

5975.content:
With the game's subtitles on, the mod's actions carry captions of their own: "The Blind Spot clot draws breath",
"The Wayfarer passes a corridor gate", "The light is whole again": one line per action, not the names of the recordings
it is built from.

5976.content:
Every world of the mod has its own soundscape — not music, but the place itself. For example, the muffled steady wind of Mars (darker and
slower at night) and the rolling steam of the Breath. Each biome adds its own layer: an airy drone with a distant shimmer on the
Martian Plains, a warm breathing tone in the Martian Dunes, a deep stone drone in the Martian Canyons, cold wind over ice on the
Martian Polar Cap, and the warm hum of charged air in the Vapors of the Breath. Now and then something short sounds nearby —
pebbles, a whirl of wind, cracking ice or a rockfall on Mars; thunder, sizzling acid and clinking glass on the Breath — and caves
have their own rumble. Every few seconds a quiet phrase of two to four notes plays on different steps of a scale (a mallet on Mars,
a chime on the Breath).

5977.content:
The ambience sits under the game's own sounds: footsteps, mobs and your voice chat stay on top. Its volume is the game's
"Ambient/Environment" slider; under a roof and in caves the background is quieter, and so it is during world weather (weather has
its own sounds). On low Mod graphics the notes play less often and the phrases are shorter. The mod setting Ambience sounds turns it off.

5978.content:
The mod’s hints, alarms and messages never cover each other: every line has its own place, and when it gets crowded the
less important one gives way.

5979.content:
**Top center** — boss bars, their phase hints and event banners, then the jump progress, the autopilot, anomaly alarms
and the mod line while in a ship.

5980.content:
**Below the crosshair** — central alarms (“no fuel for take-off”, a comet jet) and the ore scanner summary; the more
important one stays closer to the crosshair.

5981.content:
**Above the hotbar** — the mod line; it steps around recent chat messages and the suit bars, and fades over the chat while
you are typing.

5982.content:
**Corners** — the comms header (ship, deck, big moments) top left, the target and effect icons top right, coordinates
bottom right. The task card yields its corner to the comms header.

5983.content:
When there is not enough room, a less important line first gets shorter (a single line) and then folds into “+N” at the
end of its column — and comes back as soon as there is room again.

5984.content:
The mod's windows follow the game's GUI Scale setting, like the game's own screens: Auto looks as before, and a smaller scale
makes a window smaller and gives it more room (on 1366×768 and larger screens); to make them larger at the same scale, use
Mod window size. The mod's HUD stays as it is.

5999.content:
On your first visit the journal is already in your hand. When you complete a stage, a line above the hotbar says so and

6000.content:
The first time you open it, the journal asks about the **mod graphics** — low, medium or high. You can change it later in

6001.content:
Stages with a structure made of several blocks (the larger telescopes, rockets, the radio telescope, the emitter, the
shipyard, the gate ring) have a **scheme** in the journal: you can turn it and view it layer by layer. The **“Show in the
world”** button places a ghost of the structure on the ground a few steps in front of you (or on the block you are looking
at, if it is close) — it appears from the bottom up, with a column of light above the spot. Only you see the ghost. Build
over it from the bottom up: the lowest unfinished layer is brighter, the heart is golden, and blocks with something in the
way are red. If you were looking at the sky or at your feet, a line above the hotbar tells you which side the ghost is on
and how far. The same button in the journal removes it; a finished structure removes the ghost by itself.

6002.content: The journal shows every recipe of an item: the one earlier on the path comes first, and the arrows beside it switch to the rest.

6003.content:
Every stage you act on has a **How to use** part on its page: steps with your own keys, conditions and limits, and what to do when it does not work. The **Manual** tab gathers those pages in
one searchable list; hold G over an item in any window to open its page — even before its stage is open. The same pages are here: Manual. A finished stage keeps its task.

6004.content: The game's own advancement window (L) has five tabs of the mod: Advancements.

6005.content:
Joined a friend on a server who has gone far ahead, or the other way round? A  carries knowledge
from one journal to another. Blank copies are crafted from a book and quill, a glow ink sac and stardust:

6006.content:
**Fill it**: hold a blank copy with your Star Journal in the other hand and right-click. It costs 8 stardust. Pages fly from
the journal into the copy; the copy's tooltip says whose records they are and how many stages and finds they hold. Your own
filled copy can be filled again with fresh records.

6007.content:
**Write it in**: the friend takes the filled copy and right-clicks; no journal needed in hand. Everything is written in at once,
quietly, with no stage rewards; what the reader already had stays. A stage page that came this way says "Copied from the
journal of …" instead of "Completed". The copy is blank again afterwards.

6008.content:
**What it carries is knowledge**: journal stages, found constellations, worlds, rifts and vents (so the friend can travel
there), the Atlas of Life, spectra, ship blueprints, navigation records and the understood signs of
the gate script.

6009.content:
**What stays personal is deeds**: first landings, victories over masters and guardians, events lived through, tablets read
and their rewards, your own rockets, ships, station and beacons, the trust and tasks of the peoples.

6010.content:
Your own copy does nothing for you ("give the copy to a friend"), a copy of a copy cannot be made, and a copy is written in
only once. A world remembers up to eight unread copies per author: the ninth fades the oldest one.

13347.content: Carry the sealer's oldest wax to the elder: the Mother's cocoon in the Queen Cell is to be sealed.

13349.content: Climb the Amber Tower and bring the amber worker two diamonds to cut amber with.

13351.content: Carry two pieces of hive amber from the amber worker to a vein opener of the Facetkin in the Glass Cell.

13353.content: Bring the chorus tender thirty-two blocks of end stone and sixteen pinches of bone meal for new chorus tubs.

13355.content: Live through the day the combs remember the Flight and bring the chorus tender sixteen pieces of chorus wax caught in the air.

13357.content: Look at the gap in the Comb Bridge and bring the cell builder six iron ingots and twelve pieces of flint for new chisels.

13359.content: Live through the Waking of the Hive, when the shell-cousins climb out of the combs.

13361.content: Follow a drone's dance to a sealed cell, open it, and bring the drone warden two pieces of hive amber from inside.

13363.content: Bring the drone warden sixteen lumps of coal for the smoker.

13365.content: Go down into the Wax Deeps — the old hive inside the columns — and come back up.

13367.content: Wake the Mother of the Comb at the bottom of the Wax Deeps and defeat her.

13368.content: The Ring Hums Like the Combs

13369.content: Wake the gate ring of the Hive: the door between the cells.

13371.content: Bring the chief of a comb chorus wax and hive amber to seal new cells in the comb's row of memory.

13373.content: Find a Shulker Nest in the Hive, where the cousins who chose the hard shell over the soft life still live.

13375.content: Go to the Queen's Cell and let the Elder Nurse rest — she still tends the empty cell the Mother left.

13377.content: Live through the Flight of the combs in the Hive and bring the chief chorus honey for the Flight song.

13379.content: Find the Wax Hall and bring the master of seals shulker shells, so the kin who fell there can be sealed properly.

13381.content: Find the Queen's Cell and bring the master of amber hive amber from the cocoon, where the oldest wings are caught.

13383.content: Walk the road the drones dance — find a Drone Perch and a Purpur Arch — so the head drone warden knows the dance is still true.

13385.content: Bring the swarm pilot six pieces of chorus quartz from the islands of the Interrift.

13387.content: Fly to the Vigil Eye, the station of the Lashkin by the rift of the Eye, and come back.

13389.content: Bring the swarm pilot four pieces of hive amber for the lamps of the Queen's Court.

13391.content: Bring the swarm pilot four lumps of runaway wax: runaway drones leave it when they fly off the hull of a slow ship.

13393.content: The small glass folk of the Facet, whose heads are hollow cut crystals with a light burning inside.

13394.content: Three Lights of the Rough World

13395.content: Bring the vein opener twelve pinches of glowstone dust, four glow ink sacs and eight patches of glow lichen: the light of your own world.

13397.content: Find the Prism Gate on the plain, and be in the Gem when its veins surge.

13399.content: Bring the prism cutter sixteen pieces of nether quartz: the cutting wheel eats grit.

13401.content: Watch a crystal grow out of the Gem and bring the prism cutter eight blocks of prism glass.

13402.content: Cut Glass for the Breathing Isles

13403.content: Carry a lens cut from prism glass to a glassblower in the Breath.

13405.content: Quiet three refractors: reflections that fell out of broken mirrors and drink the light.

13407.content: Find the Mirror Hall and bring the mirror keeper two refractor lenses to set into its broken mirrors.

13409.content: Show the mirror keeper two lens crystals from the Eye: tears of the world that looks.

13411.content: Live through the ringing of the Gem and bring the resonance tuner four resonant shards knocked out by the loud rings.

13412.content: An Echo from the Rough World

13413.content: Listen at the Resonance Ring and bring the resonance tuner two echo shards from the deep dark of your world.

13414.content: The Heavy One in the Yard

13415.content: Look at the Endersmith Forge and the guard in its yard, and bring the endersmith eight blocks of obsidian for the hearth.

13417.content: Carry the edge the endersmith forged from a splinter of the Dark to the elder: it will cut the first facets of the newborn.

13419.content: Go down into the Prism Deeps, the old home of the First Cut, and come back up.

13421.content: Defeat the Prism Archon in the hall of mirrors at the bottom of the sanctum.

13423.content: Wake the gate ring of the Facet: the door between the worlds on the plain.

13425.content: Bring the chief of the cluster lumen dust and polished facet crystal to make new jars for the Count of Colors.

13427.content: Find the Light Well, where the white light of the Gem still runs whole before it splits.

13429.content: Find the Glass Tomb where the First Cut lie and drive off two refractors drinking the light around it.

13431.content: Stand through a vein surge with the cluster and bring the chief of the cluster glowstone dust — light from another world for a new jar.

13433.content: Find the Crystal Grove and bring the master of facets resonant shards for a prism without a single flaw.

13435.content: Find the Dust Dunes where the cluster's prism moths flew off to and bring light moss to plant along the home veins.

13437.content: Bring the seam warden six pieces of condensed void from the islands of the Interrift.

13439.content: Fly to the Drifting Comb, the station of the Comb Keepers by the rift of the Hive, and come back.

13441.content: Raise the class of your ship at a station dock, then return to the seam warden.

13443.content: Let a flock of skein weavers lead your ship to a cache: stay slow near the skein islands of the Interrift.

13445.content: A stocky gray folk of the Ash with bone plates on their skulls and shoulders and blue fire in their eyes.

13447.content: Knock the embers out of three strays — Ash Wraiths, the hooded fires of the Ash — and bring two soul embers to the soulfire keeper.

13449.content: Carry a lantern lit from the kin fire to a caravan guide: no caravan leaves the camp without it.

13451.content: Drive four bone gnawers off the fallen Giants for good and bring the bone carver two gnawer fangs.

13453.content: Find a gnawer burrow and show the bone carver a piece of soul marrow taken back from the thieves.

13455.content: Bring the felt maker twelve blocks of white wool: your world's wool makes the felt warmer.

13457.content: Carry eight blocks of soul cinder from the felt maker of the Ash to a felt maker of the Fruiting Folk in the Mycelium.

13458.content: The Sledges That Would Not Sit

13459.content: Find the Frozen Caravan of the strangers and bring the caravan guide four soul briquettes from its stores.

13461.content: Live through the Ghost Caravan and bring the caravan guide three bones from the cache it leaves behind.

13463.content: Bring the caravan guide two pieces of sorrow quartz, tears of the Lament set into crystal, from where the glass weeps.

13464.content: What Falls Out of a Giant

13465.content: Find the Giant's Skull and bring the ash sifter sixteen blocks of soul ash from around it.

13467.content: Live through the Pale Draw and bring the ash sifter three pieces of raw wraith iron snatched before the fire takes them.

13469.content: Go down into the Giant's Ossuary under the great spine, where the old keepers lived and died, and come back up.

13471.content: Defeat the Giant's Remnant on his bier at the bottom of the Giant's Ossuary.

13473.content: Wake the ring of frames out in the ash: the gate between the worlds.

13475.content: Bring the chief of a Giantkin kin fire Giant's bone and soul embers to mend the ring of chiefs around the fire.

13477.content: Find a Soul Pyre in the Ash and sit by the blue fire that warms nobody, the way the first Giantkin did.

13479.content: Go into the Wraith Iron Cairn and lay down the Cairn Chieftain — the chief who took the kin's warmth for himself.

13481.content: Live through the soul wind in the Ash and bring the chief soul briquettes for the great laying of the kin fire.

13483.content: Find the Bone Gate and bring the master of bone bone blocks from the warm world for a new rib.

13485.content: Find the Ash Well and bring the keeper of the kin fire soul embers to replace the ones that fell into it.

13487.content: Find the Cinder Field and bring the first guide ember tufts for felt to line the sledges on the road he never came back from.

13489.content: Bring the palm keeper six pieces of ringwoodite from the rocks of the Depths.

13491.content: Fly to the Wandering Cap, the station of the Fruiting Folk by the vent of the Mycelium, and come back.

13493.content: Bring the palm keeper three pieces of soul marrow from the Ash for the Marrow Chamber.

13495.content: Squat smiths of the Forge who are cast rather than born: living gold poured into a shell of slag, with a spark breathed into the mouth.

13497.content: Bring the goldsmith ten amethyst shards: a stone for a newly cast child's first ring.

13499.content: Break six pieces of living gold from the spikes on the anvil-isles and bring them to the goldsmith for Ferra's roof.

13501.content: Put out two Gilded Knights, the Hollow ones: gold that walks with someone else's fire inside.

13503.content: Find the Giant's Anvil and bring the slag mason eight pieces of gilded slag from it.

13505.content: Stand through the Giant's Forging and bring the slag mason two pieces of raw adamant.

13507.content: Bring the slag mason four pieces of raw verdigris from the spore country under the third vent.

13509.content: Find the Pouring Bowl, where the Forge melts itself, and bring the crucible keeper a bucket of molten gold.

13511.content: Live through the Quench in the Forge and bring the crucible keeper two salamander crystals from the crust.

13513.content: Look at the broken span of the Chain Bridge and bring the chainwright twelve iron ingots for new links.

13515.content: Show the chainwright four adamant ingots: the metal that no fire bends.

13517.content: Bring the charcoal burner sixteen oak logs for the kiln.

13519.content: Carry eight pieces of charcoal from the charcoal burner to the crucible keeper, who can't leave the melt.

13521.content: Carry a salamander crystal to a soulfire keeper of the Giantkin in the Ash, where the fire is blue and gives no heat.

13523.content: Go down into the Gilded Deeps, the bell-guild's shops cut into the slag under the isle, and come back up.

13525.content: Defeat the Gilded Smith at the great forge at the bottom of the Gilded Deeps.

13527.content: Wake the ring of slag on the anvil-isle: the gate between the worlds.

13529.content: Bring the chief of a Gilded anvil gold film and living gold for new pages in the book of pours.

13531.content: Find the Ring of Embers on the isles, where the first Gilded family poured its first child.

13533.content: Go into the Salamander Den and defeat the Firegill Salamander, which ate the roof gold of whole families.

13535.content: Live through the gold tide in the Forge and bring the chief gold blocks for the common pour of the anvil.

13537.content: Find the Foundry Ruins of the bell-folk and bring the master of gold living gold from the guild's last pour.

13539.content: Find the Slag Lighthouse and bring the master of walls glowstone to light it again for whoever crosses the Spill.

13541.content: Hunt slag beetles and bring the keeper of the great crucible their shells for lids that keep the melt from skinning over.

13543.content: Bring the anvil master six pieces of ringwoodite from the rocks of the Depths.

13545.content: Fly to the Wandering Cap, the station of the Fruiting Folk by the vent of the Mycelium, and come back.

13547.content: Raise the class of your ship at a station dock, then return to the anvil master.

13551.content: Climb into the Fulgurite Spire, the tower of the deaf Ringers, and come back down to the elder.

13553.content: Defeat the Vapor Wyrm on the crown of the Fulgurite Spire.

13555.content: Wake the ring of fused frames on the Breath: the gate between the worlds.

13557.content: Live through the dragon's exhale on the Breath and bring the glassblower two bottles of dragon's breath.

13559.content: Bring the glassblower thirty-two blocks of sand: glass from sand is clear enough for toys.

13560.content: A Bell for a New Family

13561.content: Visit the Vapor Chimes and bring the bell founder sixteen blocks of fulgurite for a new family's bell.

13563.content: Carry the nameless bell from the bell founder to the elder, for the tower of last breaths.

13565.content: Live through the ball lightning on the Breath and bring the lightning catcher two pieces of charged glass.

13567.content: Find the Storm Lantern and stand a whole lightning season through under the open sky.

13568.content: A Storm for the Little Lamps

13569.content: Carry a storm lantern from the lightning catcher to a vein opener of the Facetkin, in the Facet.

13571.content: Find the Acid Shrine and bring the acid tamer four bones from its pits.

13573.content: Land your shuttle in the Hive and bring the acid tamer six pieces of chorus wax.

13575.content: Defeat two vapor drakes that hunt the mist lambs.

13577.content: Carry four tufts of cloud wool from the lamb herder to a lash weaver of the Lashkin, in the Eye.

13579.content: Cook a storm stew yourself and show it to the lamb herder who asked.

13581.content: Bring the chief of the isles fulgurite and charged glass to blow new bells for the tower of last breaths.

13583.content: Find the Fulgurite Forest, the island the sky struck so often that the first Glassbreather was fused there.

13585.content: Find the Lightning Bridge between two isles and bring the chief of the isles searing glass to mend its railing.

13587.content: Stand through a lightning season on the isles and bring the chief of the isles cloud wool for the new bell's seams.

13589.content: Find the Glass Reef and bring the master of the pipe vapor pearls for a bead without a single bubble.

13591.content: Find a Vapor Drake Nest and drive off the drakes that carry off the flock's little bells.

13593.content: Bring the breath holder six pieces of chorus quartz from the islands of the Interrift.

13594.content: The One That Does Not Blink

13595.content: Fly to the Vigil Eye, the station of the Lashkin by the rift of the Eye, and come back.

13597.content: Bring the breath holder three vapor pearls from the Breath for the Quiet Chamber.

13599.content: Make a chorus skip — touch a ripe chorus drifter with your ship under way — and bring the breath holder two chorus pods.

13601.content: The Belt Riders are living balloons of Jupiter's cloud tops who have never touched anything solid.

13603.content: Go into the Storm Bastion above the clouds, see the cages of the Milkers and come back.

13605.content: Wake the altar on the ring of the Storm Bastion and defeat the Spot Leviathan.

13607.content: Wake the old ring of stone on Jupiter: the gate between the worlds.

13609.content: See how the heavy folk guyed their Lightning Catcher, then bring the mast keeper two lightning rods and six iron chains for a young one's ma

13611.content: Live through the Great Feast — the storm front of Jupiter — while Tuvo's new mast waits for its first lightning.

13613.content: Find the bones of a cloud whale in the zones and bring the gondolier six bones for a keel built the old way.

13615.content: Make a float belt from a floater's gas sac and show it to the gondolier.

13617.content: Bring the gondolier eight mushballs for the old Belt Riders who can no longer rise above the masts.

13619.content: Find the Spot Pylon in the Great Red Spot and bring the cloud knitter eight pieces of spot crust to dye the cloud yarn red.

13621.content: Live through the comet's fall on Jupiter and bring the cloud knitter sixteen blocks of white wool to patch the burnt clouds.

13623.content: Bring the cloud knitter four tufts of cloud wool from the mist lambs of the Breath.

13625.content: Live through the sprites over Jupiter's storms, jump the rings of light and bring the storm catcher four pieces of red phosphorus.

13627.content: Defeat two vortex nautiluses that hunt young Belt Riders in the Great Red Spot.

13628.content: A Jar for the Ringed Neighbor

13629.content: Carry a jar of Jupiter's lightning from the storm catcher to the elder of the Ring Keepers on Saturn.

13631.content: Carry four ammonia crystals from the ammonia tapper to the mast keeper, to cool a mast after a big strike.

13633.content: Find the wrecked Gas Skimmer and bring the ammonia tapper a canister of helium-3 from its hold, to give it back to the wind.

13635.content: Bring the chief of the Belt Riders' knot leads and bront hide to twist a new mooring rope for the mast.

13637.content: Find the Drifting Shrine, the slab of cloud where the old Riders tied their first knot.

13639.content: Find the Milkers' Gas Skimmer and put down the Sprite Jelly that went mad in its hold.

13641.content: Stand through a storm front on Jupiter under the open sky and bring the chief copper blocks for the knot's mast.

13643.content: Drive off the ion vultures that steal the charge from the mast and bring the master of the mast copper for the burned rungs.

13645.content: Find the Balloon Laboratory and a Storm Buoy so the wind pilot can learn what the Milkers were watching.

13647.content: Bring the head catcher float bladders and sprat roe to win over the storm ray circling the knot.

13649.content: Bring the flux tapper four tetrataenite ingots and sixteen copper ingots for the collector rings.

13651.content: Carry two charged batteries from the Io Mast to a crown tender of the Crown Station at Saturn.

13653.content: Raise the class of your ship at the dock console of any station.

13655.content: Dock at the Triton Anchor, the station of the Windbearers near Neptune, and return to the Io Mast.

13657.content: Fibers of the iris that fell like lashes, took root in the white of the Eye and one day stood up to listen.

13659.content: Go down into the Iris Deeps, where the Wakeful kept their vigil, and come back up to the elder.

13661.content: Defeat the Unblinking at the bottom of the Iris Deeps.

13663.content: Wake the sleeping ring on the White of the Eye: the gate between the worlds.

13665.content: Find the Wakeful's pigment quarry and bring the pigment digger a brush.

13667.content: Live through a saccade of the Eye and show the pigment digger four pinches of iris pigment it shook out of the ground.

13669.content: Bring the pigment digger twelve copper ingots to bind the crystal beaks of the picks.

13671.content: Find the Vessel Knot and live through the Closing of the Eye with your eyes open.

13673.content: Defeat three sclera grazers that strip the vessels from the White and bring the vessel keeper two hides for patches.

13674.content: Warmth from the Dream of Gold

13675.content: Go down to the Forge and bring the vessel keeper two salamander crystals to warm a cold vessel.

13677.content: Carry four lengths of lash cloth from the lash weaver to a sealer of the Comb Keepers, in the Hive.

13679.content: Find the Lashes on the edge of the White and bring the lash weaver eight tufts of lashwort from beneath them.

13681.content: Find the Tear Duct and bring the tear gatherer twelve empty bottles.

13683.content: Live through the Gaze of the Eye and show the tear gatherer two lens crystals: tears that set where it lingered.

13684.content: A Tear for the Weeping World

13685.content: Carry a tear of the Eye from the tear gatherer to a tear gatherer of the Mourners, in the Lament.

13687.content: Find the Lens Shard and show the lens carver your spyglass.

13688.content: A New Eye for the Staff

13689.content: Carry the lens carver's new lens to the elder, for the crystal eye on the elder's staff.

13691.content: Bring the chief of the hush iris fibers and lashwort to braid a new length of the whisper cord.

13693.content: Find the Blink Gate — the Gate of the Closing, as the Lashkin say — where the first fallen lash heard the Sleeper's breath and stood up to l

13695.content: Find the Watcher Nest the Wakeful left behind and quiet two of the watchers that grew there.

13697.content: Stand through a Closing of the Eye with the hush and bring its chief tears for your knot on the cord.

13699.content: Bring the master of the lens tears and a gaze crystal for a lens that sees warmth the way the Lashkin do.

13701.content: Bring the keeper of the heart crystalline lenses and show an Eye Harness, so the hush's grazers learn to carry a rider instead of chewing th

13703.content: Bring the gaze keeper six pieces of condensed void from the islands of the Interrift.

13705.content: Fly to the Seam Prism, the station of the Facetkin by the rift of the Facet, and come back.

13707.content: Bring the gaze keeper three lens crystals from the Eye for the Tear Chamber.

13709.content: Tall, slow and quiet, the Lunarians lived on the Moon long before the first rocket.

13711.content: Bring the lens grinder sixteen pieces of quartz and four amethyst shards for grinding paste.

13713.content: Grind a moonstone lens yourself and show it to the lens grinder who taught you.

13715.content: Defeat three selenite stalkers that come close to the court in the long night.

13716.content: The Light on the Last Cairn

13717.content: Walk the Cairn Trail in the highlands and bring the lamplighter eight pinches of glowstone dust for a new lamp.

13719.content: Carry the new lamp to the elder of the court: no light goes up the trail without the elder's word.

13721.content: Carry two moonstones from the Earth Keeper to the elder of the Martians.

13723.content: Live through a meteor shower on the Moon and bring the Earth Keeper four pieces of meteoric iron from fresh craters.

13725.content: Defeat the crater tortoise that raids the hopper pens and bring its shell to the herder.

13727.content: Go down into the Selenite Catacombs, the old home of the Lunarians, and come back up.

13729.content: Defeat the Selenite Colossus at the bottom of the catacombs.

13731.content: Wake the ring of stones on the Moon: the gate between the worlds.

13733.content: Find the guests' quarry in the highlands and bring the stonecutter six pieces of raw ilmenite.

13735.content: Bring the hopper herder twelve carrots: the hoppers have not forgotten the taste of the Still One.

13737.content: Bring the Earth Keeper a bismuth crystal from Venus, the bright wanderer.

13739.content: Bring the chief of a Lunar Court carved stone and moonstone for a new stone of memory.

13741.content: Find the Cairn Trail in the highlands, where the first Lunarians to leave the deep halls raised their cairns.

13743.content: Go to the Dust Tomb on the maria and put down the guardian the old courts left at its door.

13745.content: Live through a meteor shower on the Moon and bring the chief earthshine bulbs for the vigil at the Mirror.

13747.content: Find the Moonstone Geode and bring the master of lenses moonstone and selenite druses for a flawless blank.

13749.content: Find the Fallen Lander and the Sleeping Observatory so the keeper of charts can finish the guests' road on his map.

13751.content: Drive off the dust kites circling over the court's pens and bring earthshine bulbs for the frightened herd.

13753.content: Bring the lamplighter twenty-four pieces of wiring and eight copper coils, to tie the lamps of the court wall into one chain.

13755.content: Bring the orbit watcher eight tetrataenite ingots from the belt for the rims of the great lenses.

13757.content: Carry a moonstone lens from the Stillwatch to a driller of Fear's Nest, the Martian station in Phobos.

13759.content: Find a wrecked ship in space and scan it with the ship scanner.

13761.content: Catch up with a comet in your ship, then return to the Stillwatch.

13763.content: Scan a living shoal with the ship scanner and bring the orbit watcher two ray sieves: dust rays of the belt shake them loose when a ship dri

13765.content: The people of the storms: tall, four-armed and plated in rust, with a sail along the back that feels the wind before it comes.

13767.content: Go down into the Rust Bastion in the canyon, where the garrison cut its cellars, and come back up.

13769.content: Defeat the Hematite Tyrant in the throne hall at the bottom of the Rust Bastion.

13771.content: Wake the red ring of Mars: the gate between the worlds.

13773.content: Bring the ice miner eight blocks of packed ice from Earth for the town cistern.

13775.content: Find the bareskins' drill on the polar cap and bring the ice miner four portions of perchlorate salt from its cores.

13777.content: Walk from the Face Mesa to the Opal Crown, the way every young storm warden does.

13778.content: A Notch Beside the Deep One

13779.content: Stand through a Great Dust Storm on Mars and bring down three dust devils that march on the towers.

13781.content: Carry a fire opal from the storm warden to the Earth Keeper of the Lunarians on the Moon.

13783.content: Defeat three rust scorpions that creep up to the forge from the dunes.

13785.content: Forge a hematite cuirass yourself and show it to the rust smith who taught you.

13787.content: Bring the roller herder twelve beetroots for the young rollers after a storm.

13789.content: Find the field of hematite blueberries and bring the roller herder eight blocks of hematite gravel.

13791.content: Carry six portions of perchlorate salt from the grinder to the rust smith, and do not say who offered first.

13793.content: Live through the spring geysers on Mars and bring the grinder twelve portions of perchlorate salt.

13795.content: Bring the perchlorate grinder eight pieces of hollow salt from Mercury.

13796.content: A Ring That Turns into the Wind

13797.content: Bring the rust smith six copper gears and two valves for the turning ring and the shaft of a windcatcher.

13799.content: Bring the chief of the Martian towers clay and chiseled Mars rock for a new tally stone of storms.

13801.content: Climb the Strata Butte, where the first Martian watchers cut the first notch of the count.

13803.content: Find the Storm Shelter and put down the Dune Maw that sank into the sand in front of its door.

13805.content: Live through a solar storm on Mars and bring the chief true ice for the tower cistern.

13807.content: Bring the master of the forge scorpion stingers and hematite plates for a blade tempered in venom.

13809.content: Find the Signal Dish and the Stranded Rover so the wind reader learns where the bareskins were going.

13811.content: Shear frost shags on the polar cap and bring the head herder frost wool and hematite berries for the cold nights.

13813.content: Bring the Fear driller eight pieces of raw osmiridium from the Trojan swarm.

13815.content: Carry four fire opals from Fear's Nest to a flux tapper of the Io Mast near Jupiter.

13817.content: Raise the class of your ship at the dock console of any station.

13819.content: Find a wrecked ship in space and scan it with the ship scanner, then return to Fear's Nest.

13821.content: Short, stubborn diggers of the terminator, the line between the scorching day and the freezing night of Mercury.

13823.content: Go down into the Terminator Deeps, the old storeroom of the burrows, and come back up.

13825.content: Defeat the Terminator Warden in the bottom hall of the Terminator Deeps.

13827.content: Wake the great ring of stone on the plain of Mercury: the gate between the worlds.

13828.content: Twenty Mirrors Where One Would Do

13829.content: Find the softbacks' heliostat field and bring the mirror polisher two jars of their mirror coating.

13830.content: A Shine for the First Layer

13831.content: Carry four portions of grinding paste from the mirror polisher to the salt mason, for a hatchling's first dome.

13833.content: Find the heat shield wreck on the plains and bring the salt mason two of its heat tiles.

13835.content: Live through the growth of the hollows on Mercury and bring the salt mason twelve pieces of hollow salt.

13837.content: Find the softbacks' iridium dig and bring the iridium digger four pieces of raw iridium from its face.

13839.content: Live through the magnetic tornadoes on Mercury and bring the iridium digger four pinches of iridium dust.

13841.content: Break two cinder walkers that come to the burrows looking for warmth.

13843.content: Carry a block of blue polar ice from the heat keeper to the condenser keeper of the Cloud Dwellers on Venus.

13844.content: The Hours of the Last Walk

13845.content: Find the Terminator Obelisk and bring the dawn caller three pieces of golden sulfide to re-gild its hours.

13847.content: Live through a solar flare on Mercury under the open sky.

13849.content: Forge the Linewalker's core into a twilight blade and show it to the dawn caller.

13851.content: Bring the heat keeper six copper tubes and four hull plates, to lead the heat of the day wall to the far end of the burrow.

13853.content: Bring the chief of the burrows chiseled Mercury rock and hollow salt for a new stone of the Walk.

13855.content: Find the Sun Shrine, raised where the Blaze first caught one of the Walkers.

13857.content: Go down into the Iridium Dig and put down the Quicksilver Lurker that took a digger's face.

13859.content: Stand through a solar flare on Mercury under the open sky and bring the chief sunbaked pods for the vigil.

13861.content: Drive the salt borers out of the master digger's vein and bring him raw iridium from it.

13863.content: Put down the Mirror Beetle that melts the mirrors of the Heliostat Field, and bring the master of mirrors mirror scales.

13865.content: Bring the master of the hearth cinder hearts and cinder briquettes for a hearth that lasts through the cold side.

13867.content: The heavy, stooped people of the Lament, made of dark glass, with tears that glow on their cheeks and set into crystals.

13869.content: Go down into the Tear Deeps, the first home of the Mourners, and come back up to the elder.

13871.content: Defeat the Keeper of Tears by the last lake at the bottom of the Tear Deeps.

13873.content: Wake the ring of frames by the lakes of the Lament: the gate between the worlds.

13875.content: Defeat two weeping sentinels, the glassed, so that the bell ringer can ring for them.

13876.content: When the Bell Rings by Itself

13877.content: Live through the Mourning Toll and bring the bell ringer two pieces of sorrow quartz from the fire-tears it raises.

13879.content: Find the Sorrow Choir and bring the choir singer an echo shard.

13881.content: Live through the Upward Weeping and bring the choir singer three pieces of sorrow quartz caught in a jump.

13883.content: Bring the choir singer twelve amethyst shards: the choir tunes its voices by them.

13885.content: Bring the tear gatherer two ghast tears from the Upper Fire.

13887.content: Find the Tear Falls and bring the tear gatherer eight Pele's tears from the crack above them.

13889.content: Carry a lachrymatory of the hollow's tears from the tear gatherer to a soulfire keeper of the Giantkin, in the Ash.

13891.content: Find the Glass Crypt and bring the darkglass carver a diamond for the finest cuts.

13893.content: Carry the finished face from the darkglass carver to the bell ringer, so that she is added to the strokes.

13895.content: Find the Crushed Bell of the bell-folk and bring the cistern keeper two heat tiles for the pumps.

13897.content: Live through the Great Weeping of the Lament and show the cistern keeper a bucket of tears you filled yourself.

13899.content: Bring the chief of the hollow weeping glass and sorrow quartz to cut a new Bowl of Names.

13901.content: Find the Shard Bridge over the ravine where, the verses say, the Bowl of the world first cracked.

13903.content: Find the Weeping Statue and release two of the glassed sentinels that stand around it.

13905.content: Stand under the Great Weeping with the hollow and bring the chief of the hollow tearweep for the Bowl.

13907.content: Find the Mourning Bell and bring the master of dark glass weeping glass for a face without a single chip.

13909.content: Find a Prowler Den and drive off two prowlers that frighten the tear drinkers from the hollow's veins.

13911.content: Bring the tear bearer six pieces of ringwoodite from the rocks of the Depths.

13913.content: Fly to the Hanging Anvil, the station of the Gilded by the vent of the Forge, and come back.

13915.content: Bring the tear bearer two pieces of sorrow quartz from the Lament for the Reliquary.

13917.content: Fruiting bodies of the one mycelium that is the whole world down here.

13919.content: Clear a strangler out of the Thread Loom and bring the thread weaver four glowing threads to restring the warp.

13921.content: Bring the thread weaver twenty strings: breathers' thread makes a warp that does not think back.

13923.content: Show the thread weaver an air filter, then find the Felt Nest of the puffs and come back from it.

13925.content: Live through the Spore Bloom in the Mycelium and bring the spore keeper four pinches of spore dust from the puffs.

13927.content: Live through a Fruiting in the Mycelium, take the heart of a ripe body and show it to the spore keeper.

13929.content: Carry a spore gem from the spore keeper to the elder of the Mourners in the Lament, under the deepest vent.

13931.content: Live through the Hunger of the Mycelium and bring the cap cook two pieces of raw verdigris spat out by the threads.

13933.content: Bring the cap cook eight loaves of bread: the yeast in them are the Mycelium's tiny cousins.

13935.content: Find the Lantern Mushrooms in the dark of the warped growth and bring the lamplighter eight pinches of glowstone dust.

13937.content: Carry two lantern caps from the lamplighter to the elder, who sits listening in the dark.

13939.content: Put down three stranglers in the hollows and bring the felt maker two hypha bundles to beat into felt.

13941.content: Find the Verdigris Bones, the guest the Mycelium took in, and bring the felt maker eight copper ingots for its jaw.

13943.content: Go down into the Spore Deeps, the burrows the first bell's people dug into the Mycelium, and come back up.

13945.content: Defeat the Spore Mother in the fruiting chamber at the bottom of the Spore Deeps.

13947.content: Wake the overgrown ring in the growths of the Mycelium: the gate between the worlds.

13949.content: Bring the chief of the threads spore gems and glowing thread to re-root the ring of oldest memories around the elder cap.

13951.content: Find the great Elder Cap, the oldest memory of the Mycelium, and sit under it.

13953.content: Find the Spore Tower and quiet two hypha stranglers lurking in the folds around it.

13955.content: Stand through a Fruiting of the Mycelium with the square and bring the chief of the threads glow caps for the new bodies.

13957.content: Find the Hypha Bridge the Mycelium grew across itself and bring the master of the loom hypha bundles to copy its pattern.

13959.content: Bring the head cook raw croaker legs from old croakers and pulpcap clusters, so the square's pot no longer needs the singing ones.

13961.content: Bring the spore sower four fire roses from the magma geodes of the Depths.

13962.content: The Drop That Does Not Fall

13963.content: Fly to the Last Tear, the station of the Mourners by the vent of the Lament, and come back.

13965.content: Bring the spore sower two spore gems from the Mycelium for the Spore Chamber.

13967.content: Bring the spore sower six fire pearls: they are left where the fire bubbles of the magma currents burst.

13969.content: Tall, streamlined people of the fastest winds in the Solar System.

13970.content: An Anchor for the Sinking House

13971.content: Find the guests' Sinking Station and bring the anchor hauler forty-eight blocks of cobbled deepslate and six iron chains for its anchors.

13973.content: Visit the Altar of the Dark Spot, then live through the waking of the Dark Spot out on the cloud.

13975.content: Listen to the Wind Harp and bring the wind harpist sixteen amethyst shards for a new lyre.

13977.content: Carry six warmroots from the wind harpist to a sleep keeper of the Frostwalkers on Uranus.

13979.content: Find the heaviest thing in the sky with the graviscope: the dark heart behind the Archer.

13981.content: Bring the rope braider twelve windcatcher stems and twenty-four strings to braid you a line.

13983.content: Carry the new diving line from the rope braider to an abyss diver.

13985.content: Defeat two Dark Spot maws that hang their lamps at the edge of the cloud.

13987.content: Live through the rising of the diamond icebergs and show the abyss diver two black diamonds.

13989.content: Bring the storm catcher four gale eel fins for new kites.

13991.content: Find the wreck of the guests' kite and bring the storm catcher an imaging plate — the eye from its nose.

13993.content: Live through the Scooter — the White Runner's passing — and bring the storm catcher four pinches of stardust from its sparks.

13995.content: Go down into the Abyss Vault — the guests' Hanging House under the clouds — and come back up.

13997.content: Defeat the Abyssal Gale — the Locked Wind on the bridge of the Abyss Vault.

13999.content: Wake the gate ring of Neptune: the old door between the skies.

14001.content: Bring the chief of a Windbearer anchorage polished deepslate and superionic shards for a new stone in the wall of weights.

14003.content: Find the Storm Anchor, the First Weight, and touch its bottom link as every Windbearer child does once.

14005.content: Go to the Sinking Station and defeat the Cloud Kraken holding it, so the lightweights who stayed there can be let go.

14007.content: Live through the Runner storm on Neptune and bring the chief windcatchers to braid the untying lines.

14009.content: Bring the master of lines harrier talons and string for a line that the wind cannot unhook.

14011.content: Find the Black Diamond Spire in the deep and bring the deepest diver maw lures from the dark around it.

14013.content: Find the Superionic Core and bring the master of the harp superionic shards for a string that sings below the wind.

14015.content: Bring the cargo master six osmiridium ingots for the ballast of the Anchor.

14017.content: Carry a black diamond from the Triton Anchor to an ark keeper of the Ark Bubble at Venus.

14019.content: Dock at the Stillwatch, the station of the Lunarians at the Moon.

14021.content: Bring the cargo master sixteen hull plates and eight tetrataenite ingots: a full load for the Anchor.

14023.content: Bring the cargo master three frost stingers from the ice jellies in the fields of the Kuiper belt.

14025.content: The Ring Keepers gather ice on the cloud tops beneath the rings of Saturn.

14027.content: Go up into the Ring Observatory, the old house of the Watchers, and come back down to the floes.

14029.content: Wake the altar under the observatory dome and defeat the Hexagon Sovereign.

14031.content: Wake the old ring of stone on Saturn: the gate between the worlds.

14033.content: Live through the ring rain on Saturn and defeat two ring sharks that rise after the falling dust.

14035.content: Bring the ice catcher sixteen blocks of packed ice to feed the floe, so that it does not sink into the Undercloud.

14037.content: Make a ring chakram of ring shark teeth and show it to the ice catcher.

14039.content: Find the Ice Cathedral and bring the ice carver sixteen pieces of quartz — frost that does not melt — to finish one of its arches.

14040.content: Ring Ice for the Pale One

14041.content: Carry two blocks of blue ring ice from the ice carver to an ice sculptor of the Frostwalkers on Uranus.

14043.content: Carry two helium pearls from the helium distiller to a beacon keeper, for the lamps.

14045.content: Live through the Great White Spot on Saturn and show the helium distiller four helium pearls from its cloud towers.

14047.content: Bring the amber gardener three hexblooms from under the polar storm, for the feast-day ring soup.

14049.content: Find a wild Tholin Garden in the belts and look into its hollow clump.

14050.content: A Lamp for the Waiting Ship

14051.content: Find the Moored Zeppelin and bring the beacon keeper six pinches of glowstone dust to keep its cabin lamp burning.

14053.content: Live through the ring spokes on Saturn: dark wedges running across the Crown, and charged dust over the clouds.

14054.content: A Light That Does Not Burn

14055.content: Land on Neptune and bring the beacon keeper two superionic shards: ice that glows without burning.

14057.content: Bring the chief of the floe iron chains and ring teeth to hang a new net under the hoard kept for the Crown.

14059.content: Find the Ring Shard, a piece of the Crown that fell whole — like the one the Watchers first stood on.

14061.content: Find the Pale Lighthouse and put down the Cloud Angler whose lure mimics its light.

14063.content: Stand through a ring rain on Saturn under the open sky and bring the chief blue ice to give back to the Crown.

14065.content: Drive off the frost kites that tear the net master's nets and bring frost feathers to mend them.

14067.content: Bring the master carver blue ice and rime scutes to carve a likeness of the Crown for the floe's edge.

14069.content: Bring the keeper of the light an angler lure and glowstone dust for a second lamp that cannot be mistaken for a false light.

14071.content: Bring the crown tender twelve pieces of comet ice to mend the rim of the wheel.

14073.content: Carry two helium pearls from the Crown Station to a cargo master of the Triton Anchor at Neptune.

14074.content: The Floe That Has Not Fallen

14075.content: Catch up with a comet in your ship.

14077.content: Find a wrecked ship in space and scan it with the ship scanner, then return to the Crown Station.

14079.content: Bring the crown tender four sail foils from the sail moths that wheel near Mercury and Venus.

14081.content: Amphibious farmers of the tide fields under Pontus, with a crown of amber gills.

14083.content: Bring the elder sixteen wheat seeds and eight beetroot seeds from your world, to sow beside the sea barley.

14085.content: Take the elder's barley flatbread to the eclipse watcher, who never leaves the post at noon.

14087.content: Bring the tide farmer twenty-four barley grains for the noon meal under the Mast.

14089.content: Bring the tide farmer sixteen amberberries and four tidewood saplings to plant a hedge along the sea bank.

14091.content: Drive off the pard that raids the herd — slay one in the parasol forest at night — and bring the herder sixteen parasol fences and two leads

14093.content: Bring the herder four bales of hay from your world and twelve amberberries for the stormy tides.

14095.content: Bring the herder eight woolhorn fleeces, shorn with shears.

14097.content: Slay two sawjaws where the shallows fall away into the deep sea, and bring the shoal gatherer two sawjaw teeth.

14099.content: Bring the weaver thirty-two stalks of tide sedge.

14101.content: Show the weaver a module blank and bring four aquamarines, so the weavers can weave surf-stone into armor linings.

14103.content: Take two aquamarine beads from the weaver to the eclipse watcher for the rim of the eyepiece.

14105.content: Bring the shoal gatherer sixteen golden mats and sixteen shell gravel for the lower beds.

14107.content: Mine six aquamarines from the tidestone and bring them to the shoal gatherer.

14109.content: Be out on Thalassia when the tide mist rolls in, and bring the shoal gatherer sixteen tidal mud from the shallows.

14111.content: Watch the aurora of Pontus over Thalassia with a spyglass in your inventory.

14113.content: Take two glow bellflowers to the Earth keeper of the Lunarians on the Moon of your world.

14115.content: Bring the chief of the tide fields eight aquamarines and four glow bellflowers to re-ring the Eclipse Mast.

14117.content: Find the Drowned Hamlet in the shallows, then bring the chief thirty-two tidal mud and sixteen cobbled tidestone to raise the old bank by th

14119.content: Show the chief a full stack of barley grains grown by your own hands, and three loaves of barley flatbread for the noon meal.

14121.content: Bring the chief barley grains, golden mats and a parasol sapling to sow the bed under the Mast in your name.

14123.content: Bring the master weaver blue and cyan dye and twenty-four tide sedge to finish the cloth of high tides.

14125.content: Bring the keeper of the shadow a clock of your world and four amethyst shards to mark the noon shadow more exactly.

14127.content: Bring the head fieldsman four parasol saplings and sixteen bone meal to raise a giant parasol over the noon shade.

14129.content: Gentle giants of Uranus who walk on their knuckles and count their lives in days, each day forty-two years long: the planet lies on its side

14131.content: Go up into the Frost Citadel in the floating ice and come back down to the wintering.

14133.content: Wake the altar in the throne hall of the Frost Citadel and defeat the Cryo Monarch.

14135.content: Wake the old ring of stone on Uranus: the gate between the worlds.

14137.content: Defeat three diamond crabs that cut the catchers' nets and bring the diamond catcher two diamond splinters for the funnel rims.

14138.content: A Year's Work in a Blink

14139.content: Live through the great diamond hail on Uranus and show the diamond catcher three diamonds you caught.

14140.content: The Spark of the First Fire

14141.content: Find the Clathrate Fountain in the calm band and bring the clathrate opener eight methane crystals from its frozen spray.

14143.content: Carry four blocks of methane ice from the clathrate opener to the sleep keeper, for the stacks of the Long Night.

14145.content: Bring the clathrate opener sixteen lumps of coal: warmth that does not sulk, for the stacks of the wintering.

14147.content: Defeat two cryo wisps that circle the halls of the wintering at every blink.

14149.content: Sew a cyan down parka and show it to the sleep keeper.

14151.content: Find the guests' Cryo Vault and bring the ice sculptor two cryo linings from its capsules.

14153.content: Live through the methane frost on Uranus among the growing needles of ice — with a Heating Unit in your suit.

14155.content: Find the Tilted Observatory and bring the tilted astronomer two pieces of optical glass from the guests' tower.

14157.content: Live through the aurora of Uranus: stand in the pillars of light to catch the solar wind and step out before the field turns over.

14158.content: A Question for the Deep Blue Cousin

14159.content: Carry four lying stems from the tilted astronomer to a wind harpist of the Windbearers on Neptune.

14161.content: Bring the chief of a Frostwalker dome blue ice and diamond splinters to cut a new notch in the pillar of days.

14162.content: Moths in the Middle of the Night

14163.content: Find the Frozen Probe in the calm clouds — the moth that came to the Cradle during the Long Night and froze on the wing.

14165.content: Go into the Cryo Vault and put down the Thawed Specimen — the sleeper the moths laid in a box without warmth.

14167.content: Live through a methane frost on Uranus and bring the chief blocks of coal and methane ice to keep the dome's Ember alive.

14169.content: Find the Ice Bridge and bring the master of the chisel diamonds for a chisel hard enough to finish it.

14170.content: The Station That Does Not Answer

14171.content: Find the Ghost Station in the haze and bring the keeper of the tilt the moths' circuit boards from it.

14173.content: Find a Diamond Cairn and bring the head catcher puff fruit to lure the sloths that graze there to the dome.

14175.content: The Cloud Dwellers once drifted in the cool cloud deck of Venus under living bubbles, until the great storms tore them open.

14177.content: Go down into the Acid Deeps under the plains, where the grandmothers of the Cloud Dwellers pumped the sky, and come back up.

14178.content: Let the Mother Below Fall Silent

14179.content: Defeat the Acid Matriarch in the deepest tank of the Acid Deeps.

14181.content: Wake the great ring of stone on Venus: the gate between the worlds.

14183.content: Bring the condenser keeper two buckets of water from Earth.

14185.content: Find the Old Probe on the plains and bring the condenser keeper its imaging plate — the plate that remembers what it saw.

14187.content: Bring the condenser keeper two shards of superionic ice from Neptune.

14189.content: Live through the metal snowfall on Venus in a lead helm of your own and bring the frost scraper six pieces of metal frost.

14191.content: Make a bismuth halberd yourself, climb the Tessera Steps, and show the blade to the frost scraper who sent you.

14193.content: Live through an acid storm on Venus, quiet four acid toads and bring the acid brewer two of their glands.

14195.content: Find the sulfur pools on the plains and bring the acid brewer three pieces of golden sulfide from their beds.

14197.content: Quiet three acid toads that come to lick the sulfur off the piles of the walkways.

14199.content: Live through a volcanic eruption on Venus and bring the bridge builder sixteen blocks of basalt for new pile footings.

14201.content: Find the bridge over the lava, defeat two lava serpents that hunt in its bed and tell the bridge builder who built it.

14203.content: Find the Cloud Harbor in the highlands, see how the last bubble is tethered, and bring the bubble weaver four iron chains.

14205.content: Carry an air filter woven by the bubble weaver to a frost scraper, for the visor.

14206.content: A Skin for the Red Wind

14207.content: Carry three sulfur membranes from the bubble weaver to a storm warden of the Martians on Mars.

14208.content: A Heart for the Cold Grate

14209.content: Bring the condenser keeper two compressors and eight copper sheets for a condenser that makes its own cold.

14211.content: Bring the chief of the Cloud Dwellers lead and chiseled Venus rock to sheathe the first pile of the walkway.

14213.content: Find the Brimstone Spires, the needles of rock that tore the living bubbles of the Drift.

14215.content: Go to the Burst Dome, where the guests from the Dewdrop fell too, and put down the flytrap that grew in their garden.

14217.content: Stand through an acid storm on Venus under the open sky and bring the chief water for the last verse.

14219.content: Bring the keeper of water copper tubes and valves to rebuild the old condenser on the top board.

14221.content: Bring the master of bridges hull plates and iron chains for a span over the acid gully.

14223.content: Bring the master weaver sulfur membranes and string for a bubble big enough to answer a cloud whale.

14225.content: Bring the ark keeper sixteen blocks of packed ice and two buckets of water for the garden of the Ark.

14227.content: Carry two bismuth crystals from the Ark to an orbit watcher of the Stillwatch near the Moon.

14229.content: Catch up with a comet in your ship and bring the ark keeper twelve pieces of its ice for the Seed Bubble.

14231.content: A light scout from the shipyard: a titanium arrow with crescent wings, a bubble canopy and two helium engines that burn pale blue.

14233.content: A pot-bellied hauler: a wide hold striped black and yellow like a bee — the loading marks of the shipyard — a cockpit on the nose, four engi

14235.content: A long-haul explorer: narrow wings that are solar arrays from tip to tip, like the wandering albatross that crosses an ocean without a wingb

14237.content: A fighter: short and mean, with forward-swept wings, an armored slit of a cockpit and a sting at the stern.

14239.content: The Lunarians' ship: a biconvex lens of moonstone and titanium with a huge glass at its heart and a ring of small lenses round the rim, like

14241.content: The Ring Keepers' ship: a small bronze gondola inside a huge crown of ice vanes — a sail that catches the solar wind as Saturn's rings catch

14243.content: A void scout: two pairs of broad wings of purpur-colored membrane with eye-spots, a downy body, feathered antennae.

14245.content: The Comb Keepers' hauler: a cluster of hexagonal chitin cells sealed with amber wax — every cell is a hold.

14247.content: The Facetkin's explorer: a triangular prism of prism glass that splits the rifts' light into colors — a rainbow fans out behind its stern.

14249.content: A void fighter: a chorus branch whetted into a spear — dark obsidian, purple thorns in every direction and a long sting at the prow.

14251.content: The Lashkin's ship: curved like a lash above the Eye — white as sclera, with a golden iris at the cockpit and a fringe of fine ribs along it

14253.content: A depth scout: lithe as a fire salamander — a black hull with bright yellow blotches (a real salamander wears the same: "don't touch"), claw

14255.content: The Gilded hauler: heavy as a giant's anvil, with a horn at the prow and a flat face of a deck.

14257.content: The Fruiting Folk's explorer: a mushroom cap above a stalk of a hull, glowing gills under the cap and a lantern of spore gem hanging from th

14259.content: The Giantkin's warship: a hammerhead of bone and basalt on a long haft, blue soul-fire runes burning along the bone.

14261.content: The Mourners' ship: a drop of the Lament's dark glass with lilac light inside and a tail like a falling tear.

14264.content: A raider interceptor taken in battle: shoot out its engines and the crew bails out, leaving the hull.

14266.content: A raider interceptor taken in battle: shoot out its engines and the crew bails out, leaving the hull.

14268.content: A raider interceptor taken in battle: shoot out its engines and the crew bails out, leaving the hull.

14270.content: A raider gunboat taken in battle: a broad hull in patches of every color, guns on outriggers, a twin-boom tail and trophies bolted to the ar

14272.content: A raider gunboat taken in battle: a broad hull in patches of every color, guns on outriggers, a twin-boom tail and trophies bolted to the ar

14274.content: A raider gunboat taken in battle: a broad hull in patches of every color, guns on outriggers, a twin-boom tail and trophies bolted to the ar

14276.content: A raider tug taken in battle: a cockpit off the axis, a long spine with crates lashed between the ribs, a block of four engines and a mast.

14278.content: A raider tug taken in battle: a cockpit off the axis, a long spine with crates lashed between the ribs, a block of four engines and a mast.
